script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Sports
Theme: friendship

Begin screenplay.

Title: GAME ON

INT. RECREATION CENTER - MORNING

Three friends, MIKE (mid-30s, athletic, optimistic), JEN (early 30s, adventurous, determined), and RICH (early 30s, analytical, competitive), gather around a table, leafing through a community center brochure.

MIKE
(picks up a volleyball flyer)
Hey, check this out! Co-ed volleyball league starting next week. We should sign up!

JEN
(smiling)
I love playing volleyball! And it's a great way to meet new people.

RICH
(thoughtful)
Sure, I could use some exercise. But what if we're not as good as the competition?

JEN
(laughs)
Then we'll practice. Besides, it's not about winning, it's about having fun.

MIKE
(nods)
Agreed. But I have a feeling we'll be a force to be reckoned with.

EXT. RECREATION CENTER - LATER

The trio walks into the rec center, signing up for the volleyball league. They exchange excited glances as they receive their team number and schedule.

INT. MIKE'S APARTMENT - NIGHT

The friends sit at the kitchen table, strategizing their team's strengths and weaknesses. They plan practice sessions and set goals for improvement.

MIKE
(looking at a volleyball)
We'll be unstoppable, guys!

JEN
(grinning)
Bring it on!

INT. GYM - DAY

The friends practice their skills, from serving and setting to passing and digging. They laugh and encourage each other, improving with every drill.

RICH
(to Mike)
Your serve is getting better!

MIKE
(to Rich)
And your blocking is on point!

JEN
(to Jen)
My spikes are becoming unstoppable!

INT. RECREATION CENTER - WEEK 1 GAME

The friends, now part of the "Aces," face their first opponents, the "Thunderbolts." They struggle initially but find their rhythm, relying on each other's strengths.

JEN
(to Mike)
Let me serve, I've got this!

MIKE
(cheering)
You've got the whole team behind you!

JEN serves, and they win the point. The friends exchange high-fives, their morale boosted.

INT. RECREATION CENTER - WEEK 2 GAME

The Aces improve week by week, their teamwork and friendship growing stronger with each victory and loss. They learn from each other, pushing one another to be their best.

RICH
(to Mike)
You're a natural at this!

MIKE
(to Rich)
And you're the glue that holds us together!

INT. RECREATION CENTER - FINALS

The Aces make it to the finals, facing their toughest opponents yet, the "Champions." The game is intense, but the friends' unwavering support for each other shines through.

JEN
(to Rich)
We've got this, man!

RICH
(to Jen)
Together, we're unbeatable!

MIKE
(to the team)
Remember, it's not about winning or losing, it's about the friends we've made and the fun we've had.

INT. RECREATION CENTER - POST-GAME

The friends gather at the end of the season, proud of their accomplishments, regardless of the outcome. They celebrate their wins and learn from their losses, knowing that the memories and friendships they've made are priceless.

MIKE
(raising his bottle of water)
To friendship and sportsmanship!

JEN and RICH
To the Aces!

They clink their water bottles and share a heartfelt laugh, their bond stronger than ever.

FADE OUT.

End screenplay.
